touches.text: An external device (5.8.3.7.2): aider is a program we don't control; the shim adapts it.

Builders are a family: anything that adapts every builder to Cairn goes in a base builder shim class shared by cc, aider, hermes and the rest; a base class, not a device. What adapts one builder stays in that builder's device.
External (eg Claude Code): a program we don't control; the shim does the adapting that lets it exist here.
The shims handle all interfacing with the outside world: a device that needs to speak a foreign protocol (eg OpenAI's wire format) does it in its shim.
Hollow runs: proves a proof goes red when the build is removed.
